source_note: Chinese hot-topic candidates are collected from public trend pages; English wording is matched to supplied official English headlines when possible, otherwise suggested neutrally.

topics.official_english: Zhao Xintong becomes world No.1 in snooker
topics.why_hot: Zhao Xintong, a Chinese snooker player, has reached the world No.1 ranking, a milestone for Chinese sports and a source of national pride.
topics.share_angle: Highlight Zhao's achievement and the rise of Chinese athletes in international cue sports, with context on the global snooker scene.

topics.chinese_topic: 省长叶建春任上被查 江西省委表态
topics.official_english: Governor of Jiangxi under investigation; provincial Party committee responds
topics.why_hot: A sitting provincial governor being investigated is a major anti-corruption development, drawing close public attention to political accountability.
topics.share_angle: Explain the basic facts of the case and the official response, while maintaining a neutral tone on China's anti-corruption campaign.

topics.chinese_topic: 翼龙无人机进入西藏吉隆勘察
topics.official_english: Wing Loong UAV deployed to survey disaster-hit Gyirong in Tibet
topics.why_hot: The use of a large drone for post-mudslide assessment in a remote area demonstrates how technology aids disaster response.
topics.share_angle: Discuss the role of UAVs in emergency management and how China applies technology to natural disaster relief.

topics.chinese_topic: 西藏吉隆泥石流原因查明
topics.why_hot: After a deadly mudslide in Gyirong, Tibet, the public wants to understand the cause and what lessons can be learned to prevent future disasters.
topics.share_angle: Summarize the official explanation and explain the geological and meteorological factors behind mudslides.

topics.chinese_topic: 男子3万买“良方”牵出9000万大案
topics.official_english: Man's 30,000 yuan 'miracle cure' purchase leads to 90 million yuan fraud case
topics.why_hot: A health scam that started with one man buying a costly 'miracle cure' expanded into a huge fraud case, alerting the public to medical misinformation.
topics.share_angle: Analyze how such scams exploit patients' hopes and emphasize the importance of verifying health products and information.

topics.chinese_topic: 浙江提升防台风应急响应至一级
topics.official_english: Zhejiang raises typhoon emergency response to Level 1
topics.why_hot: A powerful typhoon threatens Zhejiang, a populous coastal province, and authorities have activated the highest emergency response level.
topics.share_angle: Explain China's four-level emergency response system and how coastal regions prepare for typhoons.

topics.chinese_topic: 天池竟是巨型“不锈钢盆”
topics.official_english: 'Heavenly Lake' turns out to be giant stainless-steel basin
topics.why_hot: A scenic spot called 'Heavenly Lake' has gone viral after being revealed as a giant stainless steel basin, sparking humor and debate about fake tourist attractions.
topics.share_angle: Explore the quirky side of China's tourism industry and the public's reaction to artificial attractions.

topics.chinese_topic: 短剧演员称演男主片酬200元一天
topics.official_english: Short-drama actor says male lead pay is 200 yuan a day
topics.why_hot: A short-drama actor's disclosure of extremely low pay for a lead role highlights the harsh working conditions in China's booming micro-drama industry.
topics.share_angle: Examine the economics of the short-drama sector and discuss broader labor rights in the entertainment industry.
